python3 << 'EOF'
# Data (in thousands of dollars)
# January 1960
Q1 = 4807819  # Total collections
P1 = 26461    # Unemployment insurance

# March 1960
Q2 = 11893553  # Total collections
P2 = 20174     # Unemployment insurance

# Arc elasticity formula (midpoint method)
# ε = (ΔQ/ΔP) * ((P1 + P2)/(Q1 + Q2))

delta_Q = Q2 - Q1
delta_P = P2 - P1

print(f"Delta Q: {delta_Q}")
print(f"Delta P: {delta_P}")

# Calculate arc elasticity
epsilon = (delta_Q / delta_P) * ((P1 + P2) / (Q1 + Q2))

print(f"\nArc elasticity: {epsilon}")
print(f"Arc elasticity (3 decimal places): {epsilon:.3f}")
EOF
